episode_title: Elena Verna on Product-Led Growth (PLG), B2B Acquisition Loops, and Monetization Strategy
transcript:
Lenny: Welcome Elena Verna, growth advisor and former growth executive at Miro, Amplitude, and SurveyMonkey. Elena, how do you define true Product-Led Growth (PLG)?

Elena Verna: PLG is not just putting a 'Start Free Trial' button on your website. True Product-Led Growth means the product itself is the primary driver of acquisition, retention, and expansion. If users cannot derive value independently without talking to a salesperson, you do not have PLG; you have sales-assisted self-serve.

Lenny: What are the key metrics for measuring PLG loop health?

Elena Verna: You look at three core metrics: Time to Value (TTV), Natural Rate of Growth (NRG), and Expansion Efficiency. Time to value must be measured in minutes, not days. If a user signs up and hasn't experienced the core aha-moment within their first session, 80% of them will never return. Secondly, Natural Rate of Growth measures how fast your revenue grows purely from self-serve product usage without paid marketing.
